visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large group of people, mostly young adults, are gathered in a semi-enclosed walkway. They are looking through thick vertical metal bars into a dimly lit animal enclosure. In the background, a large, greyish animal, possibly a rhino, is partially visible in the shadows. The lighting is natural but shadowed by the architectural overhang. Yellow and black text overlays are present at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot of a woman with curly brown hair wearing a beige uniform shirt with a 'FLIR' logo strap. She is holding a handheld thermal imaging camera and pointing it towards the enclosure. Several men around her are holding professional cameras and smartphones, capturing the demonstration. The background shows a brick wall and a white bag. (3) A close-up of the woman shows her gesturing towards the screen of the thermal camera. The camera screen displays a colorful heat map (yellow, orange, and purple) against a dark background. She has a focused expression, looking down at the device. The lighting is bright and even on her face. (4) The camera focuses on the group's reaction; a young man with longish black hair and several others look on with expressions of curiosity and slight confusion. They are holding up their phones to record. The setting appears to be an indoor or sheltered area of a zoo or research facility with visible red piping on the ceiling. (5) A final close-up shows hands holding the thermal camera, where a finger points to a bright orange heat signature on the screen that clearly outlines the shape of a large animal's body and head. The interface shows temperature readings and settings.
